limits: Parameter resolver tables are immutable inputs; changed tables require a new resolver.
Sampler annotations keep one current context per RT/PBT; concurrent mutation of shared chemical annotations is not supported.
This change does not fix scoring-term annotations, global resolver cache lifetime, or the libraryless-heavy-chi filter demonstrated by the next probes.
Setup timing includes sampler construction and first annotation, but excludes resolver construction, source-object copies, sampling, scoring and packing.
The old RT table index is a scalar tensor; the new value is a Python integer as declared by its schema. Values are exact; storage byte totals exclude Python object overhead.
The first profiler comparison rejected this intentional scalar representation difference; the comparator was corrected before reporting timings.
Suites overlap and should not be summed as unique coverage.
